scripts.dev: node scripts/check-local-api-port.mts && npm run build && npm run db:migrate && concurrently --kill-others --names api,web "npm run dev -w api" "npm run start -w web"
scripts.start: node scripts/check-local-api-port.mts && npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w api && npm run db:migrate && concurrently "npm run start:api" "npm run start:web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w api && npm run build -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared -w api -w web && tsc -p scripts
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w shared -w api -w web
scripts.test: npm run build -w shared && npm run test -w shared && npm run test -w api && npm run test -w web
scripts.test:all: npm run build -w shared && npm run test -w shared && npm run test -w api && npm run test:all -w web
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test
